subject: English
passage: Brain imaging research led by cognitive psychologist Zoe Anderson found that bilingual speakers showed heightened neural activity in Wernicke's area (the portion of the brain associated with language processing) when reading texts in their second language; ______ the bilinguals' responses were normal when reading in their native language. These findings suggest that second language comprehension may require additional cognitive resources even among proficient speakers.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer because 'conversely' logically signals the contrast between the two experimental conditions. The text establishes that bilingual speakers showed 'heightened neural activity in Wernicke's area' when reading in their second language, then presents the opposite finding: 'the bilinguals' responses were normal when reading in their native language.' The transition 'conversely' appropriately indicates this reversal, highlighting that the same participants showed different neural patterns depending on which language they were reading.
